# Madbury Road

> > Premium outdoor furniture retailer specializing in FSC-certified Indonesian teak, all-weather wicker, and Sunbrella-cushioned collections for New England homes.

Founded in 2010 by Tim & Brady, Madbury Road offers curated outdoor furniture collections including the Fiji, Capri, Bali, and Pacific lines. The company emphasizes sustainable materials like FSC teak, HDPE (High Density Polyethylene), and commercial-grade aluminum with weather-resistant Sunbrella fabrics for coastal and residential outdoor living spaces.

## Key Topics

- FSC-certified Indonesian Teak
- Sunbrella Cushions
- All-Weather Wicker
- Outdoor Sectionals
- Teak & Rope Construction
- HDPE (High Density Polyethylene)
- Capri Collection
- Fiji Collection
- Bali Collection
- Pacific Collection
- 8-Person Dining Sets
- Aluminum Frame Furniture
- New England Outdoor Living
- Sustainable Outdoor Furniture
